quote: [CR2] answered the Isaiah 8:3-4 bound with 8:8 and 9:6-7, while [DR3] presses the sign's own bounds; the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
why: The judge weighed CR2's chain (8:8, 9:6-7) against DR3's chain (the sign's own bounds) as chains by footing rather than demanding either side's own verse state the contrary in its own words.
